mass_includes: camera, mounting parts and moving cable, per user
assumptions: Interpret 22mm as the perpendicular component; its direction is approximate from the photograph.
+X points toward the fingers. Approximate the camera-side perpendicular offset as +Z; lateral Y is unmeasured and set to zero.
Use the camera casing centre as the combined payload COM approximation; mounting and cable COM were not separately measured.
Use joint5/joint6 averaged from the read-only wrist capture as the measurement posture; these angles were not recorded with the photograph.
Treat the added payload as a point mass; its intrinsic inertia is unknown.
Offline prediction reduces joint4 gravity compensation relative to the mass-only model. This is not a verified fix for wrist sag.
